faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Pop icon Robyn on her career, dancing, and single motherhood
kurzfassung: Amy Poehler welcomes Swedish pop icon Robyn to discuss her enduring musical hits, her upbringing among avant-garde artists, and the realities of being a single mother. They explore the cultural differences surrounding body image, privacy, and aging in the music industry. The conversation also highlights Robyn's unique perspective on creativity and performance.
stichpunkte: Zara Larsson shares her admiration for Robyn and asks about the creative process
Robyn reflects on her early career and the decision to take control of her label
Discussion on the viral New York subway sing-along of Dancing On My Own
Growing up with artistic parents in an independent Swedish theater company
Overcoming fears of single motherhood through IVF and embracing vulnerability
The physical importance of dance, getting on the floor, and stage performance
Cultural contrasts between Swedish openness to nudity and American prudishness

clips.hook: Hundreds of people lifted up by their friends
clips.text: During a festival set playing Midnight Sun twice, hundreds of audience members spontaneously hoisted their friends into the air.

clips.hook: Finding the courage to cut off hair
clips.text: In the past, interviewers frequently questioned how she managed to summon the bravery to wear short hair.

clips.hook: The doctor chooses the donor for you
clips.text: In Sweden's fertility process, medical professionals select a matching donor rather than letting parents browse characteristics themselves.
An American family member felt slightly out of place when everyone else went swimming without bathing suits during the summer.

beschreibung:
Robyn loves to lie down on the floor. Amy hangs with the Swedish pop star and talks about dadaist theater, how to stay out longer at the club, and her favorite Swedish holidays.

Host: Amy Poehler
Guests: Zara Larsson and Robyn
